Couple arrested after scaling Empire State Building for proposal stunt

Two individuals were arrested after climbing to the antenna of the Empire State Building in New York City. They unfurled a banner with a message about peace and love, reportedly as part of a marriage proposal. The pair accessed the spire, which is significantly above public areas, and were apprehended by authorities.
